newsitem.title: USA: Exxon restarts Baton Rouge, La, unit after fire.
newsitem.headline: Exxon restarts Baton Rouge, La, unit after fire.

text.p: Exxon Corp said it restarted the 68,000 barrel per day reformer at its Baton Rouge, Louisiana refinery after a small fire idled the unit Monday evening.
The reformer was down for "only a few hours" and caused no supply disruption to Exxon's customers, according to company spokesman Bruce Tackett.
Exxon is continuing its investigation into the cause of the fire, Tackett added. The refinery has a total capacity of 432,000 bpd.
((-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620))
